name: Prism Sound
source:
Main character tried to gather friends for a band to make "shining sound" together. That dream was forgotten, but now a year later he repeats that attempt.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公曾想召集朋友组建乐队，共同奏出“闪耀的声音”。这个梦想被遗忘了，但一年后，他再次尝试。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
